feedback.Physical Object: Included — It is a discrete, fixed installation with clear physical boundaries.
feedback.Biological/Biomimetic: Excluded — No biological inspiration or origin.
feedback.Powered: Included — Requires electrical power to operate.
feedback.Structural: Included — Housed in engineered structures that contribute to system deployment.
feedback.Observable: Included — Perceptible visually and through instrumentation.
feedback.Physical Medium: Included — Composed of hardware and physical infrastructure.
feedback.Active: Included — Actively emits radar signals and processes responses.
feedback.Intentionally Designed: Included — Built to monitor and coordinate aircraft traffic.
feedback.Processes Signals/Logic: Included — Interprets signal returns to identify and track aircraft.
feedback.State-Transforming: Included — Internally changes system state based on detection.
feedback.Human-Interactive: Excluded — While used by humans, the radar itself does not interface directly as part of its operation.
feedback.System-integrated: Included — Functions within air traffic management infrastructure.
feedback.Functionally Autonomous: Included — Operates continuously with minimal human intervention.
feedback.System-Essential: Included — Core to the safe operation of national/international airspace systems.
feedback.Symbolic: Excluded — Does not act as a symbol or representation.
feedback.Signalling: Included — Continuously transmits structured spatial data to human and machine recipients.
feedback.Rule-governed: Included — Operation follows strict timing, frequency, and safety protocols.
feedback.Compositional: Excluded — Composition exists but is not identity-defining.
feedback.Normative: Excluded — Does not enforce social or behavioral norms.
feedback.Meta: Excluded — Does not reference or reflect on its own conceptual structure.
feedback.Temporal: Included — Time intervals and detection windows are fundamental to its function.
feedback.Digital/Virtual: Included — Signal interpretation and decision-support processes are digital and software-defined.
feedback.Social Construct: Excluded — Its existence is independent of societal belief.
feedback.Institutionally Defined: Included — Its function and authority are codified by regulatory airspace institutions.
feedback.Identity-Linked: Excluded — Not tied to social or personal identity.
feedback.Regulated: Included — Air traffic systems are governed by international safety standards.
feedback.Economically Significant: Included — Essential to global aviation safety and commerce.
feedback.Politicised: Excluded — Not inherently a subject of political contestation.
feedback.Ritualised: Excluded — Not part of cultural rituals.
feedback.Ethically Significant: Included — Impacts safety of human life in transit and system fairness.

encoding_notes: This encoding reflects the radar unit as a cyber-physical, signal-emitting infrastructure at the core of regulated airspace control. It includes autonomous operation, digital computation, structured data signaling, and institutional embedding. Social and economic traits are justified due to its systemic safety and industry-critical role.
